topic.title: 백신 접종 옵션 논의하기
topic.description: 다양한 백신 접종 옵션에 대해 의료 전문가와 상담하며 정보를 얻는 대화입니다.

korean_scripts.korean_text: 안녕하세요, 선생님. 백신 접종 옵션에 대해 좀 여쭤보려고요.
제가 맞을 수 있는 백신들과 각각의 효과 및 부작용에 대해 알고 싶습니다.
현재 A형 백신이 가장 효과적이라고 알려져 있습니다. 90% 이상의 예방 효과가 있고, 흔한 부작용으로는 가벼운 발열이나 근육통이 있을 수 있습니다.
B형은 효과가 약간 더 낮고 접종 횟수가 더 필요합니다. A형을 추천합니다.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Hello, doctor. I wanted to ask about vaccination options.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Hello, doctor. | I wanted to ask about vaccination options.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, what vaccines are you curious about?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, | what vaccines are you curious about?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I'd like to know about the vaccines I can get and their effectiveness and side effects.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I'd like to know about the vaccines I can get | and their effectiveness and side effects.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Currently, Type A vaccine is known to be the most effective. It has over 90% effectiveness, and common side effects may include mild fever or muscle soreness.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Currently, Type A vaccine is known to be the most effective. | It has over 90% effectiveness, | and common side effects may include mild fever or muscle soreness.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: What about Type B vaccines, then?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: What about Type B vaccines, then?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Type B is slightly less effective and requires more doses. I recommend Type A.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Type B is slightly less effective | and requires more doses. | I recommend Type A.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, I will get the Type A vaccine. Thank you.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, I will get the Type A vaccine. | Thank you.
